_note: The update dialog over the front end (shared/util/updater.gd, docs/release.md §7); Hebrew in update_strings_he.json.
installing: Installing the update: the game starts again.
download_failed: The update failed: this version stays; it tries again on the next start.
no_write: The update cannot write to %s: move the game to a folder you can write to.
failed: The update did not install: this version stays.
setup_steps: Setup has %d steps to run again after a change.
data_inside: The data folder is inside the game's folder: choose another data folder in setup, then update.
stuck: The update could not put the old version back: move %s back to %s.
setup_steps_one: Setup has 1 step to run again after a change.
dont_ask_note: Ticked: Update downloads every update from now on, Later stops checking. Change it in the settings.
